justification: Both surfaces depict upright human-like figures with extended limbs, but A shows tiny stick-like schematic figures and a boat-like line scattered loosely across a rock face, while B shows a single large, anatomically detailed winged figure with beard, headgear, patterned garment and held vessel, framed by vertical bands of floral rosettes. Beyond the universal category of 'a human figure', there is no shared specific motif, relationship or compositional scheme, and the rendering conventions (minimal stick outlines vs modelled naturalistic relief with dense internal detail) are wholly different.
